definition.text: Binding to a chaperone protein, a class of proteins that bind to nascent or unfolded polypeptides and ensure correct folding or transport.

results.name: transcription coregulator activity

definition.text: A transcription regulator activity that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Coregulators often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription coregulators modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators.

results.comment: Usage guidance: Most transcription coregulators do not bind DNA. Those that do usually bind DNA either in a non-specific or non-direct manner. If a protein binds DNA specifically, consider annotating to GO:0003700 DNA binding transcription factor activity.

synonyms.name: RNA polymerase II transcriptional cofactor activity

definition.text: Binding to a transcription coregulator, a protein involved in regulation of transcription via protein-protein interactions with transcription factors and other transcription regulatory proteins. Cofactors do not bind DNA directly, but rather mediate protein-protein interactions between regulatory transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery.

synonyms.name: RNA polymerase II transcription cofactor binding
RNA polymerase II transcription coregulator binding

results.name: protein folding chaperone

definition.text: Binding to a protein or a protein-containing complex to assist the protein folding process.

results.comment: Note that a protein folding chaperone binds an unfolded protein to fold it. Do not confuse with unfolded protein holdase activity, which binds an unfolded protein and keeps it unfolded to deliver it to its final destination.

synonyms.name: protein binding involved in protein folding
